title: I made this mini game with AI - which helps to market my big game, and you may consider doing the same.
author: Officialpolygrafix
selftext:
So now that anyone can produce content, the struggle for marketing or getting attention on your game becomes the most difficult challenge, and i thought about it, and had an idea on this, that any of you can do.

I made this game using AI. The complete game is 100% AI, with the exception of the prompt itself.  
[https://stripclubempire.com/stage-tips/](https://stripclubempire.com/stage-tips/)  
a free mini game- accessible from my website, that runs in line with the THEME of my full game.  
It's not a mini game in my full game, nor is it even the same genre, it's just running through a similar theme, and therby likely attracting a similar audience. Thats the goal, not a demo, but just a similar themed game.   


Now, My full game is NSFW, so i won't post it here, but the free game is SFW (made for adults not kids- but still SFW). 

The mini game serves as a funnel to help drive traffic to the full game. Thats it.  As mentioned it's free, so there is no financial barrier to stop anyone from playing it, and Since it's web based, it's very accessible. 

So here is the thing i want you guys to take away from this.   
If you're making simple free web based games and don't know what to do with them, it's possible you can utilize them to funnel to bigger projects you have in mind or plan to develop. If no bigger project, it's possible that your free game may be a good fit for another bigger game, and you can funnel traffic to their game and work out a deal with them based on conversions from teh traffic you send. maybe a long shot but possible, and in any case, it's just an idea, do with it what you will.

comments.author: -Unpaid_Wizard-
comments.body: I am actually doing the same however the mini game is .. sorry to be rude .. way better than that.

replies.author: Officialpolygrafix
replies.body:
it's not rude at all. Its a low effort mini game and i know it.   
It does funnel to a high effort game that i've been developing that i will be charging for.   
But the idea that these simple ai games can be used as a marketing tool is the takeaway, and you can always refine until you come up with something you like.  This is a first pass on a simple idea. It's not my grand finale, nor should it be. I just did this quickly using ai.   
  
I saw someone on twitter/x posting about a tennis game they made using ai. Seemed to have some suggestions that may not stick like charging subscription for it, etc. But heres the thing, it's not just for marketing a bigger game, these type of advergaming can be used for products or services as well.

His game was about tennis, [https://x.com/teovito/status/2102686586723033440?s=20](https://x.com/teovito/status/2102686586723033440?s=20)  
Looks pretty good right?   
Now think, he could sell that to a company that makes tennis balls, racquets, or even tennis coaching services. The takeaway from this is trying to stroke the imagination of the people in here to expand beyond " look at this simple game i made with ai- how do i charge for it?"   
and think in terms of using it for marketing.
